spec_provided_observability.name: PxIS / IS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-port and global interrupt status — every error / completion event leaves a trace bit (write-1-to-clear).

spec_provided_observability.name: PxSERR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: SCR1 error register — ERR + DIAG fields capture every Link / PHY / Transport error (Internal, CRC, Handshake, DataIntegrity, 10b decode, PhyInternal, COMWAKE, PhyRdy Change, Exchanged, Unknown FIS, etc.).

spec_provided_observability.name: PxTFD
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Shadow of device Task File — STS + ERR; software inspects after PxIS.TFES to know what the device reported.

spec_provided_observability.name: PxSSTS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: SCR0 — current link state (DET / SPD / IPM).

spec_provided_observability.name: PxSACT + PxCI
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Outstanding command bookkeeping; combined with hCccComplete / CCC_PORTS for CCC observability.

spec_provided_observability.name: Received FIS Structure
spec_provided_observability.purpose: DSFIS / PSFIS / RFIS / SDBFIS / UFIS sub-areas in system memory contain the most recently received FIS of each type — software can dump them for postmortem.

spec_provided_observability.name: PxCMD.CCS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Current Command Slot — points to the slot the HBA is currently servicing.

spec_provided_observability.name: BIST FIS (0x58)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Software can build a BIST Activate FIS in a Command Table and set Command Header B bit to put the device into a BIST loopback mode (vendor-defined tests).

spec_provided_observability.name: Activity LED
spec_provided_observability.purpose: When CAP.SAL=1, the HBA drives a per-port activity LED visible at the connector / chassis.

spec_provided_observability.name: BIST (PCI cfg)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Optional PCI BIST Capability at PCI cfg offset 0Fh — Stat BIST set 1 to invoke; Completion Code reports pass/fail.

scope_observability: Standard SATA link analyzers (LeCroy SAS/SATA Protocol Analyzer, JDSU 880 Anritsu MD8480C class) capture every primitive + FIS on the differential pair at the connector.
Digital sampling oscilloscope (DSO) on A+ / A- / B+ / B- with appropriate fixtures characterizes OOB envelopes (COMRESET / COMINIT / COMWAKE), eye diagrams, and de-emphasis settings.
DEVSLP sideband is a single-ended digital signal — visible on any DSO; assertion latency vs PxCMD.ICC=8h write is measurable.
ate_or_dft: AHCI does not specify a JTAG / scan path. The HBA silicon itself uses vendor-internal scan + ATPG; the PHY uses BIST loopback at Gen 1/2/3 controllable via the BIST FIS path or via vendor PHY test registers.
notes: AHCI's debug philosophy is software-driven postmortem — every per-port status / error bit is preserved in the memory-mapped register file and in the Received FIS Structure until software acknowledges it. No protocol-level handshake hides errors from system software; PxSERR is bit-accumulated across multiple events until written 1 to clear.
